name: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate

fee.note: USD 200 plus applicable taxes as required by local law. No free retakes: each attempt, after a 14-day wait, costs the full fee.

exam.format: 45 scored multiple-choice questions plus up to 10 unscored items, 90 minutes, proctored online or at a test center through Kryterion, in English, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese or Korean. No test aids. Code is in SQL where possible, otherwise Python.

scope: Foundational data engineering on the Databricks platform: ingestion and loading, transformation and modeling with Spark SQL and PySpark, Lakeflow Jobs, CI/CD, troubleshooting and optimization, and governance and security with Unity Catalog.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Databricks does not publish passing scores; it says they are set statistically and can change as the exam is updated.
This entry follows the exam version published May 4, 2026 (exam guide updated August 6, 2026). Databricks asks candidates to recheck the exam guide two weeks before their exam date.

Recertification is due every two years. The exam guide offers a Data Engineer Associate renewal exam or the current full exam, while the listing and the certification FAQ only mention retaking the current full exam.
